title: KP dev visual review inbox

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Approved generated-quality roadmap and current phase.

verification: npx playwright test focused dev review reader and editor browser cohorts
node production route closure and review skill validation
allowedWork: Dev-only visual review protocol, capture providers, overlay, local persistence, repository CLI, and personal kp-review-logs skill.
Semantic reader exemplar first, with a mandatory human visual checkpoint before other development surfaces.
Focused tests, one commit per slice, durable Theseus evidence, and production-closure proof.
disallowedWork: Do not repair animation visuals or change mathematical content, choreography, routing, scroll authority, or static output.
Do not add production review UI or enabled production review endpoints.
Do not add cloud sync, automatic screenshots or video, drawing tools, issue-tracker integration, or automatic conversion into Theseus work.
Do not generalize beyond the reader before human approval at s20.
goal: Build a default-development, production-excluded visual review inbox that captures reproducible semantic and temporal feedback, persists append-only comments, and exposes unread review logs through a validated kp-review-logs Codex skill.

slices.title: Review acceptance contract
slices.summary: Encoded and tested the immutable dev-review acceptance boundary before implementation.

slices.title: Versioned review protocol
slices.summary: Added and typechecked the renderer-neutral kp.dev-review.v1 wire contract.

slices.title: Strict validation and limits
slices.summary: Strict schemas reject unknown, unsafe, oversized, malformed, and out-of-range review payload fields.

slices.title: Build and environment identity
slices.summary: Captured normalized browser, viewport, accessibility preferences, and build fingerprints without personal or filesystem fields.

slices.title: Temporal ring buffer
slices.summary: The bounded trace retains recent immutable render samples, excludes future frames, and rejects competing clock order.

slices.title: Semantic pointer target
slices.summary: Pointer feedback resolves reader selector, object, transformation, and material-owner ids plus clamped normalized geometry.

slices.title: Review session model
slices.summary: Review sessions remain stable across tab reloads, rotate by build, and store no user, cookie, or filesystem identity.

slices.title: Append-only local store
slices.summary: Validated events append in call order to private local JSONL, replay strictly, and fail closed on corrupt input.

slices.title: Query status and cursor projection
slices.summary: Derived inbox state preserves append-only storage while supporting ordered concurrent notes, lifecycle status, and monotonic per-consumer cursors.

slices.title: Dev-only HTTP adapter
slices.summary: Review routes are absent without an injected service and capability header, enforce JSON and size limits, and preserve existing API behavior.

slices.title: Default dev-server enablement
slices.summary: npm run dev injects an absolute local review root; direct and production server starts remain disabled unless explicitly configured.

slices.title: Repository ignore and retention policy
slices.summary: Review logs survive runs under gitignored .kp storage, never auto-expire or upload, and remain separate from disposable scratch and source evidence.

slices.title: Typed browser client
slices.summary: The browser client infers protocol types, attaches the local capability, validates outgoing captures and incoming notes or inboxes, and surfaces typed transport failures.

slices.title: Capture-provider registry
slices.summary: The review shell can select registered providers by capability and priority without importing reader, editor, graph, or code internals.

slices.title: Reader capture provider
slices.summary: Dev reader frames now expose exact checkpoint, progress, transformation, phase, focus, motion, fit, layout, font, owner, and temporal evidence after render, with production-gated emission.

slices.title: Shadow DOM review shell
slices.summary: The isolated fixed shell matches reader color, typography, and focus tokens; opens and closes by keyboard; fits 320px; prints nothing; and does not alter document dimensions.

slices.title: Comment capture interaction
slices.summary: Opening captures exactly once, displays checkpoint progress phase and route, submits by button or command-enter, preserves failed text, and recaptures only on a fresh open.

slices.title: Default dev mount and production removal
slices.summary: The real reader auto-mounts and captures in Vite dev, while production emits no review UI, events, client endpoint strings, bootstrap chunk, or enabled server route.
